summary: Correctly fixes the bug by skipping order_by expressions in GROUP BY when ordering originates from Meta.ordering (self._meta_ordering set), matching the existing logic that already strips Meta.ordering from ORDER BY. Minimal, targeted change consistent with Django conventions.

issues.description: Guard suppresses ALL order_by contributions to GROUP BY whenever _meta_ordering is set, not just the Meta.ordering-derived ones. In practice _meta_ordering being truthy means order_by was fully populated from Meta.ordering (explicit query.order_by/extra resets it), so this is safe, but it relies on that invariant rather than filtering per-expression.
